neighbours.label: a causal or contrast connective opening a clause (since, because, while) (guess)
fire: Detectives are working with the state police since they had two similar thefts.
Since the bridge was shut, we took the ferry.
The paint is thick, while most primers are thin.
We stayed home because of the storm.
They moved north, since rents were lower there.
She cancelled because her car broke down.
The soil is sandy, while the valley floor is clay.
Since nobody answered, I left a note.
